description: A scheduled sequential group's next queued member (Afternoon Member) has its own schedule (13:00-14:00) and its window is still closed at 12:58, so a group pass skips it. A global request is checked against, and takes the place of, the member the pass would actually play (Member Y), and the skipped Afternoon Member is marked played the way a pass skips it. So at 13:01, with its window open, it doesn't come back ahead of Member Z.
